scope: isolated Cycle 10 r4 hosted proof workflow
causal_timeline: 06:22:43Z GitHub run 35314617060 started on exact r4 candidate.
06:23:07Z isolated Railway container started healthy in hosted-staging mode.
06:23:20Z credential-bearing HeadlessChrome/152.0.0.0 session started against the isolated host.
06:23:23Z browser proof failed on planner-surface assertion after authentication.
Post-run correlation showed existing credential-browser policy only covered credentials sourced directly from GitHub secrets, not provider-derived credentials retrieved at runtime.
root_cause: Browser credential safety was classified by credential source syntax instead of by credential-bearing behavior. A workflow could fetch WFM_STAGING_PASSWORD from Railway after deployment and inject it into a browser session without passing the approved Chrome floor preflight that protects direct GitHub-secret browser proofs.
systemic_learning: Credential-bearing browser controls must be source-agnostic. Any path that can retrieve, materialize or inject authentication material into a browser must satisfy the same browser security floor before the credential becomes available to the proof process.
prevention: Add a source-agnostic browser security floor module with deterministic version-boundary fixtures.
Require the browser security floor before Railway provider-variable retrieval, not merely before browser launch.
Add a structural validator proving floor -> provider credential retrieval -> browser proof ordering.
Keep the workflow read-only at repository permission level and repository-owner-only.
Fail closed on missing/unparsable/old approved Google Chrome; do not fall back to unverified Chromium for credential-bearing proofs.
recovery_rule: Do not run the credential-bearing hosted browser proof until an approved runner exposes Google Chrome at or above the recorded Linux security floor. Non-credential HTTP/static/provenance checks may continue independently.
open_uncertainty: The failed Cycle 10 browser assertion also revealed that the weekly planner DOM was visible but not recognised by the Cycle 10 grid heuristic; that is a separate UX/product defect and is not masked by this security containment.
The existing draft credential-workflow registry PR should ultimately absorb provider-derived credential paths so there is one repository-wide policy rather than parallel controls.
safety_boundary: No production/customer deployment, workforce/payroll mutation, tenant mutation, credential rotation or security-control weakening performed.
